title: Terrarium
tagline: Protecting Endangered Species from poachers, Easter Delicacies and Enabling Wildlife Conservation
description: This project combines decentralized Pokt Network as a provider, Semaphore Protocol for proving membership of Terrarium Conservation Group sending signals (Votes, Endorsements) on species protection using Zero Knowledge, XMTP for secured conversations amongst the NFT holders of the endangered species, Sygma to inter chain operability with Polygon and planning to launch in optimism, cartesi computation layer for consensus and wildlife conservation on GNU/Linux based Mobile OS enabling compatibility with Mobian OS, Ubuntu Touch for mobile devices enabling DApp through Store. Inclusive and Tangible local impact saving green iguanas from easter delicacies and exotic pets. Overall a social impact project powered by ethereum ecosystem, protects endangered species poached from the most representative fauna Biodiversity and providing an equal opportunity to 8.7 million approximate species of plants and animals in existence.
